title_zh: 文学、艺术与体育 — 第24节
body_en: Music builds rhythm for language. Sing along quietly and notice stress patterns. Describe a painting with precise adjectives. Sport teaches tough spirit: train, fail, adjust, try again. Body and mind grow together when practice is regular.
body_zh: 音乐给语言节奏。轻声跟唱，注意重音模式。用准确形容词描述一幅画。体育教韧劲：练、败、调、再试。规律练习时，身心一起成长。
